description: Turns a pull request, branch, or new task into a ready worktree for the thread, with no Git commands to type. One picker searches open PRs, local and remote branches, and existing checkouts, then says exactly what launching will do. New branches start from the freshly fetched default branch, and PRs, including ones from forks, open as detached review worktrees. Worktrees go where your path template puts them, get their submodules and .worktreeinclude files, and are never deleted. Requires BB 0.43+ and Git 2.31+ on the selected machine; the GitHub CLI is optional, for listing PRs.
